steps: Retain the original failed command/result artifact and exact 57-service sealed baseline. Inventory current images, nonsecret configuration and states, including source-ingest-controller-migrate; do not infer that initializer caused the point decoder failure.

Through the existing publisher control path, quiesce all Source writers and scheduler activity before the recovery cut. Record owner identities and the configured SOURCE_INGEST_DATA_DIR and SOURCE_INGEST_LATEST_MARKET_SNAPSHOT_PATH, including any separately mounted normalized records/receipts. Keep provider egress disabled during recovery validation.

Take an owner-controlled protected byte-for-byte filesystem backup of the current Source journal and all canonical Source records, normalized storage and receipts on their actual mounts. Inventory file lengths and SHA256 digests before and after backup; preserve originals and permissions. This is a current-state backup, not a claimed pre-write Bee projection backup. Do not export private payloads into this evidence manifest.

Explicitly select a retained immutable Source image with the full extended-v1 reader (70a is locally demonstrated, but its actual retained image ID and availability must be proved by the publisher). Bind its codec and image to retained source/build evidence. Do not select a moving tag or silently substitute it for the failed Bee image.

Before replacing any owner, use existing scripts/dev_release_artifacts.py qualify_source_reader with Docker(), the explicitly selected sha256 image ID and the publisher's existing guard check. It executes the actual selected codec with the current Source container's volumes mounted read-only. Require checksum, lineage, snapshot identity and complete historical replay success; archive only the bounded digest/size/projection proof. Reject any unknown or malformed line without changing it.

For a maintained candidate carrying this repair, also use the existing seal-candidate path: qualify_source_writer verifies the candidate's complete supported write forms against its explicitly required retained reader. A Bee rollback requirement rejects the new extended writer. Do not waive that rejection by rewriting data, clearing a file, deleting a prefix, replaying providers, relabelling provisional rows or inventing a rebuild endpoint.

Only after explicit forward-recovery selection and successful reader proof, the original publisher applies its existing controlled Compose recovery with the selected immutable Source image, the same owner mounts and sealed tenant/control/configuration posture. Preserve all journal bytes and canonical records. Keep writers quiescent until read-only startup replay and snapshot/PIT/receipt identity readback have been compared to the pre-switch proof. This procedure is a deliberate compatible-image forward recovery, never automatic fallback or exact Bee compensation.

Re-read complete state and exact image/configuration/health for all 57 baseline services. Restore the initializer's recorded exact image through the original owner path where required and verify its terminal state separately. A recovered Source API or restored public FE/BFF pair alone does not close full-stack compensation. Resume original publisher-controlled normal writers only after its real accepted readback, then retain genuine hosted evidence separately from this source PR.
